proposal: Correct ER-03.02 and DP-CASE-0018 to 47.48 MJ/kg (ISO 6976, 25 degC combustion reference).
question: ER-03.02 and DP-CASE-0018 give LHV 48.4 MJ/kg for the reference composition. ISO 6976 gives 47.48 MJ/kg (34.78 MJ/Sm3, relative density 0.598) for that composition; ALP-OWN-FUL-001 section 3 itself gives 34.4 MJ/Sm3 and relative density 0.600, which also mean about 47 MJ/kg. Guarantees are on heat input, so the error does not change them, but fuel flow, the gas booking check and the metering design use the mass LHV.
subject: Reference fuel LHV inconsistent with the reference composition
